from PIL import Image
from collections import deque

def components(fn, predicate, scale=2):
    im=Image.open(fn).convert('RGB')
    w,h=im.size
    im=im.resize((w//scale,h//scale))
    W,H=im.size
    mask=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            r,g,b=im.getpixel((x,y))
            mask[y][x]=predicate(r,g,b)
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    comps=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if mask[y][x] and not seen[y][x]:
                q=deque([(x,y)]); seen[y][x]=True; n=0; minx=x; maxx=x; miny=y; maxy=y
                while q:
                    cx,cy=q.popleft(); n+=1
                    minx=min(minx,cx); maxx=max(maxx,cx); miny=min(miny,cy); maxy=max(maxy,cy)
                    for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                        nx,ny=cx+dx,cy+dy
                        if 0<=nx<W and 0<=ny<H and mask[ny][nx] and not seen[ny][nx]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((nx,ny))
                if n>10:
                    comps.append((n,(minx*scale,miny*scale,maxx*scale,maxy*scale)))
    comps.sort(reverse=True)
    return comps

for fn in ['carton_001.jpg','carton_004.jpg','carton_005.jpg']:

    # bright: all >180
    bright=lambda r,g,b: r>180 and g>180 and b>180
    for name,pred in [('brown',brown),('green',green),('dark',dark),('bright',bright)]:
        comps=components('/home/robot/captures/'+fn,pred,scale=2)
        print(name, comps[:15])

from PIL import Image
from collections import deque

def components(fn, predicate, scale=2):
    im=Image.open(fn).convert('RGB')
    w,h=im.size
    im=im.resize((w//scale,h//scale))
    W,H=im.size
    mask=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            r,g,b=im.getpixel((x,y))
            mask[y][x]=predicate(r,g,b)
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    comps=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if mask[y][x] and not seen[y][x]:
                q=deque([(x,y)]); seen[y][x]=True; n=0; minx=x; maxx=x; miny=y; maxy=y
                while q:
                    cx,cy=q.popleft(); n+=1
                    minx=min(minx,cx); maxx=max(maxx,cx); miny=min(miny,cy); maxy=max(maxy,cy)
                    for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                        nx,ny=cx+dx,cy+dy
                        if 0<=nx<W and 0<=ny<H and mask[ny][nx] and not seen[ny][nx]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((nx,ny))
                if n>10:
                    comps.append((n,(minx*scale,miny*scale,maxx*scale,maxy*scale)))
    comps.sort(reverse=True)
    return comps

for fn in ['carton_001.jpg','carton_004.jpg','carton_005.jpg']:
    print('\n',fn)
    # coffee brown: R>G*1.3 and R>B*1.3 and R<160 and R>30
    brown=lambda r,g,b: r>30 and r<170 and r>g*1.25 and r>b*1.25 and (r-g)>15
    # green: G>R*1.15 and G>B*1.15 and G<180 and G>20
    green=lambda r,g,b: g>20 and g<200 and g>r*1.15 and g>b*1.15 and (g-r)>10
    # dark: all <80
    dark=lambda r,g,b: r<80 and g<80 and b<80
    # bright: all >180
    bright=lambda r,g,b: r>180 and g>180 and b>180
    for name,pred in [('brown',brown),('green',green),('dark',dark),('bright',bright)]:
        comps=components('/home/robot/captures/'+fn,pred,scale=2)
        print(name, comps[:15])
